task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. Your first objective is to travel north. After that, take a trip east. And then, make an attempt to venture south. After that, make an attempt to travel east. Then, make an effort to venture north. Then, pick up the keycard from the floor of the playroom. And if you do that, you're the winner!
